name: Git Plugin UI
description: DOM structure and interactions for the Git plugin. Documents the three-panel layout with left column (branch/remote selectors, staged/unstaged file lists, commit input, commit history) and right column vertically split (commit info + file tree on top, diff viewer on bottom). Covers resize handles, stage/unstage buttons, commit browsing, diff view toggle, and file change auto-refresh.

elements.leftCol: .git-left — Left panel (default 260px). Contains: branch label + select.git-select, remote label + select.git-select, .git-section-sep, .git-label Changes, .git-changes-item (Staged header with .git-collapse-arrow and .git-changes-count) + .git-changes-files (expandable file list with +/- buttons, each .git-changes-file has dataset.path), .git-changes-item (Unstaged header) + .git-changes-files, .git-commit-bar (.git-commit-input textarea + .git-commit-btn-row with Commit and Push buttons), .git-commits scrollable list of .git-commit-item elements (each with hash, message, meta).
elements.resizeHandle: .git-resize — Vertical resize handle (2px width, col-resize cursor) between left and right columns.
elements.rightCol: .git-right — Right panel, flex-grow, vertically split. Contains:
elements.topPanel: .git-top-panel — Top section. Contains: .git-commit-info (hidden by default, shows author/date/message for selected commit), .git-filetree (list of .git-file-item elements for changed files in selected commit).
elements.verticalResizeHandle: .git-resize.git-resize-h — Horizontal resize handle (2px height, row-resize cursor) between top and bottom right panels.
elements.bottomPanel: .git-bottom-panel — Bottom section. Contains: .git-diff-header (with .git-diff-btn-wrap toggle button and .git-diff-dropdown dropdown menu for unified/side-by-side selection), .git-diff-empty (shown when no file selected), .git-diff (pre.git-diff-pre for unified diff, .git-sbs-row elements for side-by-side diff).

interactions.name: select_branch
interactions.action: git:checkout(selected branch) -> refresh() rebuilds UI with new branch data
interactions.result: Commit history and changes updated for the selected branch

interactions.name: select_remote
interactions.action: git:fetch or related action -> refresh() rebuilds UI
interactions.result: Branch list and commit history updated for the selected remote

interactions.name: select_commit
interactions.action: git:showTree(commit hash) for changed files -> git:commitBody(commit hash) for commit info -> render .git-commit-info (visible) -> renderFileTree -> auto-select first .git-file-item -> git:diff for that file -> renderDiff
interactions.result: Commit details shown in top panel, first changed file's diff shown in bottom panel

interactions.name: select_file
interactions.action: git:diff(commit hash, file path) -> renderDiff in .git-bottom-panel (unified or side-by-side based on current view mode)
interactions.result: Diff for selected file rendered in bottom panel

interactions.name: toggle_changes
interactions.trigger: click on .git-changes-item header (Staged or Unstaged label)
interactions.action: Toggle .git-changes-files visibility (display block/none), flip .git-collapse-arrow between ▸ (closed) and ▾ (expanded), re-render file list with +/- buttons
interactions.result: File section expand/collapse toggled with arrow indicator updated

interactions.name: stage_file
interactions.trigger: click + button on unstaged file row in .git-changes-files
interactions.action: git:stage(filePath) -> refreshChanges() debounced to repopulate staged/unstaged lists
interactions.result: File moved from unstaged to staged list

interactions.name: unstage_file
interactions.trigger: click - button on staged file row in .git-changes-files
interactions.action: git:unstage(filePath) -> refreshChanges() debounced to repopulate staged/unstaged lists
interactions.result: File moved from staged to unstaged list

interactions.name: commit
interactions.trigger: Enter key in .git-commit-input or click Commit button in .git-commit-btn-row
interactions.action: Read .git-commit-input value -> if non-empty and staged files exist: disable Commit button, git:commit(message) -> clear input -> refreshChanges()
interactions.result: Commit created, staged files cleared, commit history refreshed
interactions.propagation: Enter in input prevented from bubbling

interactions.name: push
interactions.trigger: click Push button in .git-commit-btn-row (only enabled when git:checkAhead returns ahead > 0)
interactions.action: git:push() -> refresh() to update commit history and checkAhead status
interactions.result: Commits pushed to remote, push button disabled when no longer ahead

interactions.name: toggle_diff_view
interactions.trigger: click on .git-diff-btn or dropdown item in .git-diff-dropdown
interactions.action: Toggle dropdown visibility -> on item select: update view mode (unified/side-by-side) -> re-render current diff with new mode -> fire onStateChange
interactions.result: Diff re-rendered in selected view mode, dropdown closed

interactions.name: resize_horizontal
interactions.trigger: mousedown on .git-resize (vertical bar between left/right columns)
interactions.action: leftCol width = clamp(120, 600, startWidth + dx) -> update CSS width -> fire onStateChange on mouseup

interactions.name: resize_vertical
interactions.trigger: mousedown on .git-resize-h (horizontal bar between top/bottom right panels)
interactions.action: topPanel height = clamp(40, totalHeight - 40, startHeight + dy) -> update CSS height -> fire onStateChange on mouseup

interactions.name: file_changed
interactions.trigger: file:changed event (file system change in workspace)
interactions.action: Debounced 1s -> refreshChanges() (only staged/unstaged file lists, preserves commit selection and diff state)

interactions.name: open_file
interactions.trigger: dblclick on file in staged/unstaged list or commit file tree
interactions.action: Fire this.onFileOpen?(filePath) -> CanvasArea opens file in editor

states.empty: No git repository detected in workspace. Branch and remote selectors disabled. Empty staged/unstaged lists. Commit input and buttons disabled. Commit history empty. Right panel shows .git-diff-empty placeholder.
states.loaded: Git repository active. Branch/remote selectors populated with current branch selected. Staged/unstaged file lists rendered with expand/collapse. Commit history list populated with clickable .git-commit-item elements. Commit input enabled, Commit button state based on staged files, Push button state based on checkAhead.
states.staging: At least one staged file present. Staged section auto-expanded showing staged files with - buttons and count badge. Commit button enabled when message is non-empty.
states.diff_unified: Diff view mode set to unified. .git-diff contains pre.git-diff-pre element with monospace-formatted unified diff output.
states.diff_side_by_side: Diff view mode set to side-by-side. .git-diff contains .git-sbs-row elements with left (removed) and right (added) columns.
states.committing: Commit in progress. Commit button disabled, input may show loading indicator. After commit completes, input cleared and staged list refreshed.

lifecycle.destroyed_by: Card terminate invokes GitPlugin.destroy() — unsubscribes file:changed, removes all DOM listeners, removes root element
